skills.detail:
A close-range area attack with a chance to inflict Counter.

When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time,
perform a long-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect and an ATK debuff.
Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time,
deals a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

Become temporarily invincible after use.

skills.detail:
Skill 2 transforms into "Mil Fleurs: Fish-Man Karate: Giganteum" when Power Gauge is at max.
Skill 2 turns back into "Spider Net" when Power Gauge is no longer at max.

Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement.
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
